verdicts.title: Angels' Den 2026
verdicts.quote: If you would like information on how to apply for Angels' Den 2026, please email rsvp@theclarefoundation.org.
verdicts.for_paul: An annual event in its fourth year; the 2026 round has closed, the event is on 9 September, and the page names no 2027 date. Keep the row waiting for next year's page, or reject it as historic and re-add a fresh one?

verdicts.title: Apply for Investment (Fund Manager Route)
verdicts.quote: We invest in fund managers who provide finance or other support to social enterprises and charities, we do not invest directly the organisations themselves.
verdicts.for_paul: Better Society Capital lends to fund managers, not to charities. Nothing here for a fundraiser to apply to.

verdicts.title: Ashoka Fellowship
verdicts.for_paul: HTTP 403 behind a Cloudflare interstitial, so the page could not be read today. The row's stored brief says fellows are identified and nominated rather than applying directly; if that holds it is a reject, but it needs a browser read to confirm.

verdicts.title: B&Q Foundation Community Grants
verdicts.quote: Find out more about our charity partnerships and how we support our local communities.
verdicts.for_paul: Duplicate of the live row cb9780e6, B&Q Foundation Home Improvement & Home-Starter Kits Funds, which points at bqfoundation.org.uk. This row points at the diy.com retail site, where the foundation gets one line and no application route.

verdicts.title: Barclays 100x100 UK Community Relief Programme
verdicts.for_paul: A COVID-19 relief programme from 2020. apply_url was never Barclays' own page but an Idox GrantFinder listing, which now returns 404, so there is nothing to relink to either.

verdicts.title: Baring Foundation — International Development Programme
verdicts.quote: Please note that applications to the International Development Programme are always by invitation only.
verdicts.for_paul: Invitation only, in the foundation's own words and without qualification. The Baring Foundation's other programmes may be worth carrying separately; this one has no route in.

verdicts.title: Big Society Capital Social Investment Wholesale Funding
verdicts.quote: We invest in fund managers who provide finance or other support to social enterprises and charities, we do not invest directly the organisations themselves.
verdicts.for_paul: The same wholesaler as row 2 and the same reason: it invests in fund managers, not in charities. apply_url here is the homepage, so the sentence is quoted from the apply-for-investment page on the same site. Also a near-duplicate of row 2, though neither is live.

verdicts.title: Brighton & Hove — Fairness Fund for Communities 2025/26
verdicts.quote: The Fairness Fund is now closed to applications.
verdicts.for_paul: The 2025/26 round has closed and the page gives no 2026/27 date. The council runs it annually and the row is year-stamped in its title, so the choice is between holding this row for next year's page and rejecting it in favour of a fresh row when the next round opens.

verdicts.title: Charities and Social Enterprises Lending
verdicts.quote: Charities, social enterprises and community projects make up a large share of our customer base
verdicts.for_paul: Duplicate of the live row 6c5b16b7, Triodos Bank UK Business Loans, at triodos.co.uk/business-lending. Worth knowing before rejecting: this hidden row's URL is the more specific charities and social enterprises page, so relinking the live row to it and rejecting this one may be the better trade.

verdicts.title: Charity and Co-operative Lending Fund
verdicts.quote: For registered charities, co-operatives, credit unions and community-interest companies only.
verdicts.for_paul: Ready to publish on the page: open, lends to charities, co-operatives, credit unions and CICs, £25,020 to £10 million. Two things first. Its amount_max held £30 million, which is the total the bank committed to lend across the whole fund in 2024 rather than what one borrower can have; that is corrected to £10 million. And the full brief could not be written because a system-trust write cannot overwrite the existing ai_enrich brief.

verdicts.title: Charity Bank — Green Loans
verdicts.quote: We offer loans up to £7.5 million, with larger amounts available through partnerships with other social lenders.
verdicts.for_paul: A good row blocked by one gap. The page supports six of the seven brief fields and says nothing about how long a decision takes, so it cannot pass the depth bar. Charity Bank also has a live general lending row (72739682), so folding Green Loans into that as a product may be better than a second row.

verdicts.title: Charity Bank Loans
verdicts.quote: Charity Bank is a savings and loan bank with a mission to use money for good. We use money our savers entrust to us to make loans to UK charities, social enterprises and organisations with charitable purposes.
verdicts.for_paul: Duplicate of the live row 72739682, Charity Bank Loans for Social Purpose, at charitybank.org/loans. This row points at the bank's homepage and its amount_max of £3.25m matches nothing on it.

verdicts.title: CLA Charitable Trust
verdicts.quote: We are not accepting any further applications in 2026. We expect to re-open in December/January for our 2027 grant-making.

verdicts.title: Commonweal Housing — Call for New Ideas
verdicts.quote: Applications are open until Friday 16th October 2026.
verdicts.for_paul: Open until 16 October, which matches the row's deadline, and the fund is real. The row carries £5,000 to £10,000 and the page states no figure anywhere — it is in the downloadable Application Guide. Confirm the range from the guide or clear it, and this becomes a publish.

verdicts.title: Community Housing Fund
verdicts.quote: Organisations and groups who want to bid for revenue and/or capital funding should contact the Community-Led Housing London Hub to discuss their application.
verdicts.for_paul: Two problems. apply_url points at the GLA's funding-programmes index, where the fund is a bare link; its own page (quoted here) describes the route but gives no dates, no amounts and no exclusions, so it cannot carry a full brief. Its published allocations also stop at Q4 2024-25. Relink and confirm the programme is still running, or reject it as ended.
